svg.title: How LogMem connects
svg.desc: Your AI tools connect over MCP to one LogMem space. Every agent writes to and reads from one shared timeline.
svg.text: Your AI tools share one memory. Every agent reads the same timeline and writes to it.
Every line says which agent wrote it, from which tool, and when, to the millisecond. Before anything that can’t be undone, the agent pauses and asks.
